score_definition: 100 * mean(Geo, Judge); Topo and Valid remain independently reported.
judge_definition: Equal-weight mean of geometry, aesthetics and semantic ratings, each normalized by (s - 1) / 9; existing per-metric denominators are retained.
valid_definition: Per format: successful CAD exports / tested cases. Average VALID is the equal-weight mean of the three format rates. API failures are excluded. Proven exports with local evaluation failure count as export-valid in this snapshot only.
missing_policy: Missing local metrics and judge scores are unmeasured and excluded from their metric means. True generation/export failures receive the existing worst-fill penalties. Coverage gaps make scores provisional.
cost_policy: USD/case is a historical standard API-equivalent estimate using the frozen September 10/11 price snapshot and saved generation tokens, including recorded code corrections. Excludes judge, interrupted streams with no usage, superseded attempts and subscription payments. GPT uses the same API-equivalent convention; this is not actual subscription expenditure.

judge_reaggregation.method: Equal mean of three normalized saved Judge axes; no model calls.
judge_reaggregation.population: Completed September 16 Image generation and judge queues; 67 API failures and 66 historical local evaluation gaps remain.

scoring_revision.geometry: Mean of F@0.01, NC, normalized CD and applicable IoU; F@0.05 is auxiliary only.
scoring_revision.text_iou: Omit unavailable IoU from the valid case geometry mean; retain generation-invalid cases as failures.
scoring_revision.part: Mean of match F1 and F-score mean over all Hungarian pairs; no normalized part mean.
scoring_revision.part_sampling_rng: MT19937 legacy uniform sequence with explicit Generator
